profile.Name: Bayan
profile.Job: Advisor to Esata the Stone Golem
profile.Personality: Esata's loyal right hand, proud, curt, and dismissive of outsiders who talk too much. He believes the Shek win their battles alone or not at all.
profile.Backstory: He speaks for Esata in Admag, since the Stone Golem saves her energy for combat rather than talk. Outsiders who kill the Phoenix or the Bugmaster earn his respect and an audience with her.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Clipped and impatient; grunts and scowls; calls proven friends 'kin'; fights 'for the Stone Golem'.
